name: How long does stucco repair typically take?
description: Stucco repair can take a few hours for small issues or several days for extensive damage, depending on the scope and weather.

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stucco repair depends largely on the extent of the damage. Minor repairs, such as small crack filling or patching, might take a few hours to a day. More extensive damage, involving large sections of stucco, underlying wood, or moisture remediation, could take several days to a week. Weather conditions, especially for drying and curing, can also influence the timeline. Your contractor will provide a more precise estimate after assessing the specific repair needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco repair can take a few hours for small issues or several days for extensive damage, depending on the scope and weather.
